description: Four-function calculator whose working is held by the object itself. Term keys load the value a model variable has at the iteration on screen, and the result can be written back into a model variable.

parameters.label: Entry scale
parameters.description: Zero while whole digits are typed, then the place value the next digit takes.

parameters.label: Start a new entry
parameters.description: Set after a result or a term key, so the next digit starts a number instead of extending one.

parameters.label: Key 1
parameters.description: Model variable this key loads, read at the iteration on screen.

parameters.label: Key 2
parameters.description: Model variable this key loads, read at the iteration on screen.

parameters.label: Key 3
parameters.description: Model variable this key loads, read at the iteration on screen.

parameters.label: Key 4
parameters.description: Model variable this key loads, read at the iteration on screen.

parameters.label: Result variable
parameters.description: Model variable the equals key writes the result into, at the iteration on screen. Left empty the calculator writes nothing.
